zh.title: 新功能
items: **全新全局动效体系**：统一了整个应用的动画语言，界面切换、弹窗进出、加载状态更顺滑一致。重点修复了升级流程的视觉断裂——点击「更新」后弹窗会朝左上角平滑收拢，同时左上角进度环即时点亮，清晰指引你关注下载进度。
**自驱 Goal 模式**：新增独立的 Goal（目标）模式，可自主推进多步骤任务；Plan（计划）模式回归为纯审批门，批准后交由你掌控节奏，两种模式职责更清晰。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复流式回复过程中侧边栏会话列表偶发被清空、需切换工作区或发新消息才恢复的问题。
修复更新说明弹窗内「新功能／修复」条目丢失前导符号、内容糊成一片的问题，列表层级与间距更清晰。

en.title: What's New
items: **New global motion system**: Unified animation language across the app for smoother, more consistent transitions, modals, and loading states. Fixed the upgrade-flow visual break—after you click Update, the modal collapses toward the top-left while the progress ring lights up immediately so download progress is easy to follow.

**Self-driven Goal mode**: Added a dedicated Goal mode that can advance multi-step work on its own; Plan mode returns to a pure approval gate so you keep the pace after approve. Responsibilities of the two modes are clearer.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fixed the sidebar session list occasionally clearing during streaming replies until you switched workspace or sent a new message.
Fixed release-note bullets in the update modal losing leading markers and collapsing into a wall of text; list hierarchy and spacing are clearer.
